description.fun: Sewaddle makes its own clothes, chewing up leaves and stitching them together with sticky thread from its mouth, which makes it a popular mascot for fashion designers. Its very first outfit, though, is sewn by Leavanny when it hatches, and Sewaddle spends its time trying to copy it. When two Sewaddle meet, they greet each other by rubbing together the sensory bumps on their heads.
description.guide: Sewaddle is a Bug- and Grass-type caterpillar Pokémon that makes clothing from leaves stitched with sticky thread. It hides its head in its leafy hood while it sleeps. It evolves into Swadloon and then Leavanny.
description.tagline: A caterpillar that sews its own leafy outfit.

description.fun: Swadloon wraps itself in a cloak of leaves against the cold and spends whole days quietly eating fallen leaves, preferring soft old ones to fresh. The nutrients it makes from them feed the plants around it, so forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage. Huddled in its blanket, it may echo the shut-in hikikomori of Japanese media, and only friendship coaxes it into becoming Leavanny.
description.guide: Swadloon is the evolved form of Sewaddle, a Bug- and Grass-type Pokémon wrapped in a cloak of leaves. It lives on the forest floor eating fallen leaves, and the nutrients it produces help nearby plants grow. It evolves into Leavanny with high friendship.
description.tagline: A leaf-wrapped homebody that makes the forest flourish.

description.fun: Leavanny is the forest's nanny and tailor: when it finds a small Pokémon, it cuts leaves with the blades on its arms and sews them into clothing with sticky silk. It keeps its Eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves and makes snug wrappings for young Sewaddle. Gentle as it is, it shows no mercy to anyone who targets young Pokémon, and its arm blades can slice a thick tree in half.
description.guide: Leavanny is the final form of Sewaddle, a Bug- and Grass-type Pokémon that uses the cutters on its arms and sticky silk to make leaf clothing for small Pokémon. It is gentle and fiercely protective of young Pokémon.
description.tagline: A gentle leaf-cutting tailor that dresses little Pokémon.
